definitions.explanation: Having a wealth of experience in a particular field or activity. Used to describe people with extensive practical knowledge.

examples.japanese: {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な{医師|いし}に{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I was seen by a highly experienced doctor.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}なガイドだ。
examples.english: He is a highly experienced guide.

examples.japanese: {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}なスタッフが{丁寧|ていねい}に{対応|たいおう}いたします。
examples.english: Our experienced staff will assist you courteously.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound ({経験|けいけん} + {豊富|ほうふ}) used as a na-adjective. Very common in job descriptions, professional profiles, and introductions. Almost always modifies a person or their role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な～: an experienced ~
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}なスタッフ: experienced staff
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な{講師|こうし}: experienced instructor
- {経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}な{弁護士|べんごし}: experienced lawyer
